Bash(git commit -m "$(cat <<''EOF''
fix: update E2E tests workflow to use .NET 10 preview

The E2E tests workflow was configured to use .NET 9.0.x, but the
project''s global.json requires .NET 10 RC2 (10.0.100-rc.2.25502.107).

This mismatch caused the E2E workflow to fail with SDK not found error.
Updated the workflow to use dotnet-version: ''10.0.x'' with
dotnet-quality: ''preview'' to match the main CI/CD pipeline configuration.
